comment: Surveyed 2026-07-31 from Piscada UI screenshots ONLY (OBF SD-anlegg; native app via Citrix, no crawl/API -- OPEN_ITEMS item 6); full narrative + per-fact citations in knowledge_base/bislett_building_survey.md, screenshots in knowledge_base/incoming/piscada/pics/Bislett/. No machine-readable exports yet (GK point list pending), so systems/rooms here are HAND-CURATED from the UI. Volume model: one SubBuilding BI-STADION (the ring) carries floors/rooms (Romstyring: Uetg/2etg/3etg, NO 1. etg page); the three stand sectors (Loerdahls/Sofies/Bislett plass, named by the heating circuit titles) are separate SubBuildings used as SERVES targets -- sector<->room mapping is UNKNOWN, so rooms hang under BI-STADION and inherit NO heating type (honest gap, see OPEN_ITEMS). Heating chain verified from the plant pages: Fjernvarme -> 320.001 Hovedstokk -> 320.002/003/004 radiatorkurs (sector names in panel titles; 320.002 also feeds varmebatteri 360.001/-02, 320.003 feeds 360.003) -> 320.005 Gulvvarme (area unknown) + 320.006 Banevarme (grasrot SP 7.0 C sesongstart; track sensors RT601-608; RT607 loose sensor -21.6 C, RT608 implausible 70.0 C). Per-circuit OE401 energy meters modelled as System points (own alarm pages under Tekniske Signaler). Central nattsenking per kurs (turtemp -5.0 K on 320.002); vinterdrift below utetemp 20.0 C (hysterese 1.0 K). Rooms: tiles show temperature + heating gain (+ CO2 on 2/3 etg); SETPOINTS VERIFIED 2026-07-31 via room pictures (right-click -> Aapne -> Temperatur: Komfort/dag + Oekonomi/natt, 21.0/21.0 on U-etg samples; upper floors natt=0.0 driven by Piscada Schedule objects, e.g. Schedule_BS_320_022_RT630_SPN = 0.0 -- no setback configured anywhere at capture). Real label grammar +3B600046_563_<rom>_<komp>_<PV|C>; rooms also have KMD (systemvender) + KMD_MSV (tidsprogram) points (survey, Object properties section). Several undersentraler: BislettStadion:15039 (U-etg), :15036 (2. etg schedule). U-etg tile ids R048/R049/R052 appeared twice at capture resolution (one of each pair is probably R046/R050-area) -- recorded once each pending zoomed recapture. 360.004 heating battery appears electric (no hydronic pipes; no 320-kurs coupling) -- hypothesis in the survey, not in the graph. Solceller + Lysstyring + 310.001 exist in the menus, not yet surveyed.
